evidenceTypes.description: R00 decision record (§21.2): the accountable owner and technical release owner approve this policy revision, its legacy-gate mapping and the evidence schema
CI run of lint, typecheck, unit, integration and browser tests on the exact release SHA
Migrations applied to the candidate database by the pinned migration image; backward compatible with the running release; build-time database isolation
Critical deployed-path checks (routing, authentication, intake, media) against the exact release
Authenticated provider connectivity and send/receive/failure paths from the exact release
External checks, heartbeats and a delivered alert reaching the named on-call owner
Application rollback rehearsal that preserves inquiries and commitments accepted after deployment
Newest sealed independent recovery point (§17.3): older than 60 minutes fails the recovery target
Managed and independent restore drills into clean resources, with a named operator and a separate reviewer (§17.3)
Scoped human review (listing rows, locale and RTL, accessibility, redirects, content); establishes its stated scope only
Packaging, load qualification and security checks against the release images
URL, data and media mapping with a rehearsed final-delta procedure, from the release's own manifests
Hermes task corpus evaluation (§14) with live provider evidence and manual fallback
External observations: domains, certificates, mail DNS, Search Console, Yandex and backlinks
Candidate attestation: operator custody and cutover approval for the exact release
A complete staffed operating cycle, including overnight work and backup, signed off by the named owner

gates.title: Authority and release contract
gates.exitEvidence: Current instruction/artifact conflicts explicitly reconciled; final scope, owners, policy and evidence schema accepted

gates.title: Foundation
gates.exitEvidence: Typed domain/migrations; real identity context; allow/deny tests; command/transaction/queue invariants

gates.title: Inventory/publication
gates.exitEvidence: Seller/source/media review, exact manifests, locales, correction/withdrawal and historical dispositions

gates.title: Discovery/intake
gates.exitEvidence: Complete approved search/detail/saved/compare plus durable inquiry and staffed assignment/response

gates.title: Case continuity
gates.exitEvidence: Brief/Interests, handover, viewing/resource/ICS, proposals, documents and closeout

gates.title: Communication/privacy
gates.exitEvidence: Real provider send/receive/failure proof, grants/revocation, consent and privacy workflows

gates.title: Assistance
gates.exitEvidence: Three evaluated draft workflows, live provider evidence and manual fallback

gates.title: Migration/media
gates.exitEvidence: Complete URL/data/media mapping and rehearsed final-delta procedure

gates.title: Reliability/security
gates.exitEvidence: Packaging/load/security checks, alerts, HA, independent recovery and rollback drills

gates.title: UX/content
gates.exitEvidence: All advertised task paths, seven-locale/RTL/accessibility review, real approved copy and measured performance

gates.title: Candidate attestation
gates.exitEvidence: Fresh exact-release evidence; no unmet pre-cutover gate; operator custody and cutover approval

gates.title: Cutover verification
gates.exitEvidence: Real domains/certificates/mail DNS, intake, identity, media, URL/SEO observations and external proof for the deployed release

gates.title: Operational acceptance
gates.exitEvidence: A complete staffed operating cycle including overnight scheduled work and backup completes without an unresolved release-severity incident; named owner signs handoff

legacyGates.note: Every frozen legacy URL on both domains keeps its exact approved response (AT57). Search Console, Yandex and backlink evidence is retained: a baseline before cutover (R07) and observations after it (R11).
Redirects rest on recorded, human-reviewed URL decisions; none is invented.
Sitemaps and hreflang list only approved, published locales and agree with the website (AT27).
JSON-LD agrees with the current published revision and eligibility (AT27).

One valid human-review disposition for every in-scope listing row, keeping source-as-is authorization, factual review, media rights, translation approval and current availability distinct (§21.2 item 5).
Replaced by deployed-path checks on the new runtime for the exact release; needs owner approval under R00.
Replaced by App Platform web, worker and migration images running the pinned release (AT60); needs owner approval under R00.

The legacy contract required live Typesense/Meilisearch reports. PostgreSQL search is the final design (D04), but a PostgreSQL report neither satisfies nor waives that requirement until an explicit authority amendment is approved (§21.2 item 2). Hermes service checks map to R06 task evidence (item 6).
Alerts reach the named owner and rollback preserves post-deployment data (AT63, AT65); no older than 24 hours at attestation.

Payload is not used (ADR 0002). Replacement proof is the actual new runtime and identity evidence, including AT26 (no bypass path); a renamed component or stub endpoint is not replacement proof (§21.2 item 6). Needs owner approval under R00.
Media counts and units are reconciled and coverage is evaluated from the same release and object manifest (§21.2 item 4, AT58).
Operator-authorized Ed25519-signed recovery evidence stays required (§21.3); recovery point age follows §17.3.
